Ashurey Kreuzer Branch
Franz
Welcome.@This is the first time we've met in person,@Major Gilliam Jaeger.
Yes.
And you must be... Calvina Coulange.@I'm Franz Zeppelin, head of the@3rd Development Department.
So you know who I am.
Yes, from the data sent from the moon.
And I know next to nothing.@I have a lot of questions.
I understand, but please keep your questions brief.
Brief, got it.@Franz, are you one of the Fury?
(...That's beyond brief. It's practically blunt.)
Major Gilliam asked me the same thing before...@The answer is no. I don't know the details about them.
Didn't Seldoa Shiun tell you?
He simply entrusted me with the Bellzelute's@blueprints, and I built it here in secret.
Didn't you think that was suspicious?
And what about you? You dealt directly@with Seldoa and Alistair Lynx.
When they provided funds and technology,@their condition was that we never pry into the reasons@or the source. And we accepted it.
Even so...
For a company like ours to close the gap with@<Isurugi Heavy Industries> and <Mao Industries>,@I believed we should accept their terms and their help.
You people sided with the Fury.@And because of that, Ashurey on the moon was wiped@out... and lots of employees died.
...I know.@We must atone for that,@but right now, the urgent task is...
To complete the Bellzelute Brigandi@and entrust it to you.
The Bellzelute Brigandi...
After the moon incident, military intelligence raided@all of Ashurey. As a result, they found that another@Bellzelute was being developed here.
We guarded it quite closely, mind you...@but on their third raid, they finally saw through it.
(...You meant to keep it hidden?)
By rights, we should have been taken into custody@and the unit confiscated... but the military@offered us a deal.
I can pretty much guess.@You finish the unit here, then hand it over to@the Federation Army with all the data. Then...
What happens after that depends on@the results you bring us.
...What kind of unit is the Bellzelute Brigandi?
Put briefly, it combines Unit 2, upgraded based@on Bellzelute Unit 1's data, with the Buster Armor,@a transformable weapon unit.
That makes it larger than Unit 1, but its firepower,@mobility and durability are vastly improved.
When will it be finished?
Assembly is already complete. All that's left is@to transplant Unit 1's Cytron Control System@and run the adjustments.
Weren't you given that system?
We received the data, but we don't have the real thing.
Then we'll move up the schedule@and take the Bellzelute Brigandi now.
Understood.
I have two more questions.@Why did Seldoa have you develop a unit on Earth@superior to the Bellzelute?
He never told me why, but thinking back now...@perhaps he foresaw a situation like this one.
And your other question?
Apart from your staff here,@who knew the Bellzelute Brigandi@existed?
Probably only Seldoa Shiun@and Alistair Lynx.
(If the Fury knew about this place,@they'd have attacked it long ago...)
(Seldoa aside...@why did Al-Van let the Bellzelute Brigandi's@existence slide?)
Then let's start preparing for transport right away.
I'll ask you and your key staff to come with us.@We have permission from above.
Franz, let me take back what I said earlier.@I sided with the Fury too.
So I'll settle the score.@With the Bellzelute Brigandi you people built.
